headword: {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}

definitions.explanation: An appliance that automatically washes dishes, utensils, and cookware.

{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き} is often abbreviated to ⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧ in everyday speech.

- ⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧ (abbreviation, very common)
- ⟦{皿洗|さらあら}い{機|き}→皿洗い機：noentry⟧ (less common)

- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to run the dishwasher)
- ⟦ビルトイン→ビルトイン：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き} (built-in dishwasher)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dishwashers are becoming more common in Japanese households but are still less prevalent than in Western countries. Many Japanese kitchens are small, so compact models or sink-mounted types are popular.
